title: Watch the mix of a whole change shape through the year

styles: [scientific]

## Summer belongs to pop

These illustrative listening hours stack three genres around a centre line. The thickness of a stream is its hours; the bar at the left shows how thick a given number of hours is.

type: streamgraph
title: Pop swells in summer while rock fades
